qualities.label: Fast (S)
qualities.description: Optimized for lower-power GPUs and integrated graphics

qualities.label: Balanced (M)
qualities.description: Optimal balance of visual fidelity and rendering latency

qualities.label: High Quality (L)
qualities.description: Maximum CNN depth for discrete GPUs

modes.label: Mode A (Sharp Line Restoration & Upscale)
modes.description: Restores blurry line-art and upscales by 4x via dual 2x CNN passes with highlight de-ringing and auto-downscale; 5 unique shaders

modes.label: Mode B (Soft Line Restoration & Upscale)
modes.description: Softer line reconstruction with dual 2x CNN upscaling reaching 4x total scaling; 5 unique shaders

modes.label: Mode C (Denoise & Upscale)
modes.description: Suppresses compression artifacts and noise before dual 2x upscaling reaching 4x total scaling; 4 unique shaders

modes.label: Mode A+A (Deep Restoration)
modes.description: Two sequential passes of line restoration and upscaling reaching 4x total scaling with unique pass-2 assets; 6 unique shaders

modes.label: Mode B+B (Soft Deep Restoration)
modes.description: Two passes of soft line reconstruction and upscaling reaching 4x total scaling with unique pass-2 assets; 6 unique shaders

modes.label: Mode C+A (Denoise + Restoration)
modes.description: Denoises first pass, then applies line reconstruction on upscaled frame reaching 4x total scaling; 5 unique shaders
